name.fr-FR: Jansénisme II : seconde, troisième et quatrième Instructions pastorales (1704-1705)
name.en-US: Jansenism II: the Second, Third and Fourth Pastoral Instructions (1704-1705)
name.pt-BR: Jansenismo II: segunda, terceira e quarta Instruções pastorais (1704-1705)

author.fr-FR: François de Salignac de La Mothe-Fénelon
author.en-US: François de Salignac de La Mothe-Fénelon
author.pt-BR: François de Salignac de La Mothe-Fénelon

description.fr-FR: Les trois Instructions pastorales qui suivent la première contre le Cas de conscience : éclaircissement des difficultés proposées (1704), preuves de la tradition sur l’infaillibilité de l’Église touchant les textes dogmatiques (1705), puis la signature du Formulaire exigée par l’Église (1705).
description.en-US: The three Pastoral Instructions that follow the first against the Case of Conscience: clarification of the difficulties raised (1704), proofs from tradition for the Church’s infallibility on dogmatic texts (1705), then the signing of the Formulary required by the Church (1705).
description.pt-BR: As três Instruções pastorais que seguem a primeira contra o Caso de consciência: esclarecimento das dificuldades propostas (1704), provas da tradição sobre a infalibilidade da Igreja quanto aos textos dogmáticos (1705), depois a assinatura do Formulário exigida pela Igreja (1705).

fr-FR.editor: J.-E.-A. Gosselin (éd. Saint-Sulpice), Paris: Leroux et Jouby / Gaume

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Fénelon, Paris, Leroux et Jouby, 1851 (éd. Gosselin, Saint-Sulpice), tome 4, p. 5–337; archive.org OCR (ABBYY).
sources.description: Machine-cleaned OCR: running heads, page numbers and hyphenation removed, paragraphs rejoined, obvious character errors corrected by a vote against the corpus vocabulary; period spelling kept. Residual OCR errors remain (see PROBLEMS.md).
sources.tierEvidence: Fénelon died in 1715; the 1851 edition is public domain.
